title: MiDM: Minimal Decision Models and an audit of CLM-8B
description:
MiDM v0.2.0: typed-decision models with a LoRA adapter and pointer head, including a new Qwen3.5-9B-Base checkpoint interface. Archive contains code, aggregate matched 4B/9B evaluations, CLM DeepSWE numerical reproduction and statistical audit, SQL/Python selection, routing and concurrency pilots, and aggregate report-integration checks.

The matched retrospective tests improve some decision tasks, but not SQL/Python consistently. The learned router remains below reasoning alone. MiDM DeepSWE and local Terminal-Bench are unmeasured because matching raw evaluation artifacts are unavailable. One-date report integration does not establish financial or semantic-quality superiority. No raw benchmark examples, private predictions, financial data, report text or credentials are included. Model adapters are hosted separately on Hugging Face.
